equation: Qahera UI Kit v1.0 = Design System + Registry + AI Decision Layer

ai_guidance.core_thesis: Qahera UI Kit v1.0 = Design System + Registry + AI Decision Layer (not merely Component Library + Compiler)
ai_guidance.philosophy: A design system built for developers and AI agents.

icons.rule: QAHERA-VISUAL-001: Emoji are strictly forbidden as UI icons or visual cues. Use authoritative Qahera icon references.

keyboard.Enter: Toggles expanded state of focused accordion item
keyboard.Space: Toggles expanded state of focused accordion item

ai.purpose: Organizes deep information in vertically stacked collapsible panels.
whenToUse: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) sections
Nested product specifications or collapsible settings
avoid: All content must be visible at the same glance

accessibility.focus: Focus moved to alert on dynamic insertion if assertive

aria.aria-live: polite or assertive based on tone

ai.purpose: Displays prominent contextual messages and feedback directly within page layouts.
whenToUse: Critical form validation errors requiring review
System status or maintenance announcements
Persistent contextual instructions
avoid: Temporary floating notifications that auto-dismiss (use Toast)
Blocking confirmations that interrupt navigation (use Modal)

ai.purpose: Displays a visual representation of a user, team, or brand entity.
whenToUse: Profile pictures in navigation bars
Comment authors and team member lists
avoid: Full-size photo galleries (use Image)

ai.purpose: Displays a floating action button that monitors scroll depth and smoothly scrolls the viewport back to the top of the page.
whenToUse: Documentation pages, deep articles, or extensive product listings with high scroll depth
avoid: Fixed height viewports, modal dialogs, or short dashboard screens

ai.purpose: Communicates compact metadata, categorical status, or quantitative counters.
whenToUse: Entity state indicator (Active, Pending, Suspended, Archived)
Unread count pill or category tags
Applied filter chips in filter-bar
Delta metric tag in dashboard-stat
Interactive badge links (using asChild or href)
avoid: Prominent system-wide action buttons (use Button)
High-severity alert banners (use Alert)

ai.purpose: Displays the hierarchical path of the current page within the site structure, allowing quick navigation up the parent tree.
whenToUse: Deeply nested e-commerce catalog categories
Documentation pages and multi-tier administrative dashboards
Multi-step checkout or application funnels
avoid: Single-level top-level landing pages without parent hierarchy
Replacing primary navbar navigation

ai.purpose: Triggers an explicit user action, form submission, or state change.
whenToUse: Main page action
Form submission (primary)
Dismissal or cancellation (secondary)
Dangerous or irreversible operations (destructive)
avoid: Using multiple primary actions in the same visual container
Using as a hyperlink without action (use standard anchor)
Displaying static badge status (use Badge instead)

ai.purpose: Highlights critical editorial quotes, architectural insights, tips, or contextual notices with an elevated visual prominence.
whenToUse: Documentation guidelines, code tips, and architectural callouts
Editorial quotes and highlighted insights in blog widgets
Security reminders in billing and profile settings
avoid: Critical dismissible alerts interrupting application flows (use Alert)
Transient ephemeral messages (use Toast)

ai.purpose: Renders a lightweight atmospheric particle simulation of metallic golden embers on an HTML canvas, active in dark theme with zero CPU overhead when inactive.
whenToUse: Hero sections of luxury, celebratory, or cinematic web experiences
High-prestige dark mode interfaces
avoid: Dense administrative tables, data entry forms, or content-heavy body copy

ai.purpose: Groups related content, metadata, and actions into an elevated visual container.
whenToUse: Dashboard metric cards (dashboard-stat)
Empty state panels (empty-state)
E-commerce product items and collection cards
User profiles and settings group panels
avoid: Blocking modal confirmations (use Modal)
Ephemeral feedback notifications (use Toast)

ai.purpose: Displays an interactive sequence of slides or promotional showcases with forward/backward navigation and indicator dots.
whenToUse: Hero promotional banners in e-commerce stores
Featured editorial articles and luxury product spotlights
Customer testimonial and review highlights
avoid: Dense data tables or critical primary forms
Over-animating background elements that degrade reading focus

ai.purpose: Architectural royal enclosure and prestige container with pilliform header caps, metallic borders, and tactile papyrus surface.
whenToUse: Executive badges and verified author cards
Royal diplomas, certifications, and awards
Flagship feature callouts and hero badges
avoid: Standard high-density data tables
Generic low-prominence cards (use Card)

ai.purpose: Permits binary toggling (true/false) or multiple independent selections.
whenToUse: Agreeing to terms and conditions
Multi-item selection in data tables or filter menus
avoid: Mutually exclusive options where exactly one must be selected (use Radio)

ai.purpose: Compact interactive element representing an attribute, text tag, selection filter, or removable token.
whenToUse: Active filter pills in search bars and data tables
Tag entry inputs (TagInput)
Compact entity mentions
avoid: Main call to action triggers (use Button instead)
Passive notification alerts (use Badge or Alert instead)

ai.purpose: Visual separator delineating content blocks horizontally or vertically, with optional embedded center label.
whenToUse: Separating sections of a form or list
Inline social login divider (e.g. 'أو' / 'Or')
Vertical divider between toolbar button groups
avoid: Purely decorative border hacks

accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring on active tab buttons

ai.purpose: Displays a bottom-anchored navigation bar primarily designed for handheld and mobile viewports, providing thumb-accessible quick actions, tab destinations, and status indicators.
whenToUse: Primary mobile navigation for web apps, PWA applications, or responsive mobile views
Thumb-friendly 3 to 5 primary destinations (Home, Search, Orders, Profile, Notifications)
Floating action dock anchored to the viewport bottom
avoid: Desktop-first dashboards with extensive sidebar space (use Menu or Navbar instead)
Secondary page navigation with more than 5 tabs
Breadcrumb trails or deep page sub-trees

ai.purpose: Displays an offcanvas side panel sliding from the viewport edge for navigation, filters, or auxiliary details.
whenToUse: Complex multifaceted filter sidebars on mobile and desktop
Viewing detailed row entity or item side overview without leaving page
Mobile global navigation menus
avoid: Simple confirmations (use Modal or Toast instead)
Persistent desktop sidebar navigation (use Nav instead)

keyboard.Escape: Closes menu and returns focus to trigger

accessibility.focus: Trigger has focus; active item highlighted on open

ai.purpose: Displays a contextual floating menu revealing secondary actions or navigation links.
whenToUse: User profile menu in headers
Table row actions (kebab menu ...)
avoid: Form field value selection (use Select)

ai.purpose: Interactive drag-and-drop zone with file picker, validation status, and upload progression indicators.
whenToUse: Document, image, or media asset submission forms
Importing CSV, Excel or JSON data files
avoid: Simple text inputs
Instant zero-file single click forms

ai.purpose: Continuous architectural relief border and rhythmic decorative band for structural section dividers and header framing.
whenToUse: Section dividers with cultural or architectural flair
Header and footer boundary bands in academic/executive dossiers
Framing featured editorial showcases
avoid: Simple minimal data dividers (use Divider)
Clickable navigation bars (use Navbar)

ai.purpose: Captures a single line of textual or numeric data from the user.
whenToUse: Short textual inputs (names, emails, search queries, quantities)
Form fields within forms or modal dialogues
Search query input in search-toolbar
avoid: Multi-line freeform text (use Textarea instead)
Selecting from predefined options (use Select or Radio instead)

ai.purpose: Displays keyboard shortcut keys, key combinations, and system hotkey indicators.
whenToUse: Displaying hotkeys in dropdown menus and command palettes (e.g. ⌘K, Ctrl+S)
Technical documentation and user guides
avoid: Interactive clickable buttons (use Button instead)

keyboard.Escape: Closes open megamenu panel and returns focus to trigger
keyboard.Tab: Navigates sequentially through category links and featured buttons
keyboard.ArrowDown: Navigates down the active category column
keyboard.ArrowUp: Navigates up the active category column

accessibility.focus: Visible outline on category links and featured cards

ai.purpose: Displays an expansive multi-column navigation panel hosting categorised link lists, promotional media, feature cards, and quick actions.
whenToUse: Sites with deep architectural hierarchies and more than 15 top-tier destinations
Product suites requiring visual descriptions, icons, and featured promotional callouts
Enterprise header navigation menus
avoid: Simple linear websites with fewer than 6 links (use Menu or Navbar dropdown)
Sidebar lists inside dashboards (use Menu instead)
Mobile app primary screens (use Dock or Drawer instead)

keyboard.ArrowRight: Opens active submenu (in LTR) or closes it (in RTL)
keyboard.ArrowLeft: Closes active submenu (in LTR) or opens it (in RTL)

accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring on active and focused menu links

aria.aria-expanded: Indicates whether a nested submenu is open

aria.aria-current: Identifies current active page or route

ai.purpose: Displays a vertical or horizontal structured list of navigational links, supporting nested submenus, section headers, badges, icons, and keyboard navigation.
whenToUse: Sidebar navigation in dashboards and administrative consoles
Nested link hierarchies with collapsible submenus and section headers
Compact horizontal action strips or breadcrumb-adjacent menus
avoid: Primary top-level site header with branding and search (use Navbar instead)
Wide multi-column dropdowns with promotional cards (use Megamenu instead)
Bottom-screen thumb navigation on mobile devices (use Dock instead)

keyboard_keys.Tab: Traps focus within interactive elements of dialog

ai.purpose: Displays a blocking dialog surface capturing user attention for a critical workflow.
whenToUse: Destructive deletion confirmations (paired with confirmation pattern)
Critical multi-input forms requiring total user focus
Terms or policy approvals before proceeding
avoid: Passive feedback or status updates (use Toast or Alert instead)
Standard page content navigation

keyboard.Escape: Closes active submenus and mobile navigation drawer
keyboard.Tab: Cycles through header links and controls

accessibility.focus: Visible outline ring around active links and interactive buttons

aria.aria-expanded: Reflects open/closed state of submenus and mobile drawer

ai.purpose: Displays the primary application and page header hosting branding, navigation links, submenus, search, indicators, and actions across diverse architectural archetypes.
whenToUse: Top-level layout header for web applications, editorial portals, or marketing websites
Mobile app bar with dual icons or search capsule
avoid: Isolated single-screen landing pages without external links

ai.purpose: Provides structured multi-page navigation, direct jump controls, page size selector, and record boundary status. Inspired by composable headless primitives with rich styled variants.
whenToUse: Result sets exceed a single viewport (typically > 12 records)
Server or client paginated catalogs, tables, and card registries
Composed data tables requiring compact or icons-only pagination
avoid: Continuous infinite feeds without discrete pages
Small lists with fewer than 10 items

ai.purpose: Displays an atmospheric initial loading overlay with logo, animated progress bar, and digital percentage before revealing cinematic or rich page content.
whenToUse: First-time application loads, heavy cinematic presentations, or portfolio landing pages
avoid: Internal page-to-page SPA transitions or individual component async data fetching

striped.background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 25%, transparent 25%, transparent 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 75%, transparent 75%, transparent)

ai.purpose: Visualizes the deterministic or indeterminate completion status of an operation, task, or metric indicator.
whenToUse: Horizontal and vertical metric indicators and level meters
File upload and asset synchronization status
KPI goal completion bars in dashboards
Multi-step form completion indicators
Disk, memory, and equalizer column monitors
avoid: Discrete stepped wizard navigation (use Stepper)
Standalone loading spinners without progress context (use Spinner or Preloader)

ai.purpose: Permits selection of exactly one option from a mutually exclusive group.
whenToUse: Selecting one option among 2 to 5 visible choices (shipping, payment methods)
avoid: Independent toggles (use Checkbox)
Long choice lists exceeding 6 options (use Select)

ai.purpose: Displays quantitative star rating evaluation and user feedback capture.
whenToUse: Product reviews and customer evaluations in e-commerce
Feedback submission forms
avoid: Binary yes/no toggles (use Switch or Radio)

ai.purpose: Displays an angular or folded corner banner across cards, boxes, and product displays to indicate status, exclusivity, discounts, or new arrivals.
whenToUse: Luxury e-commerce cards (e.g. 'Royal Gold', 'Best Seller', 'New')
Discount percentages and limited-edition badges on product cards
Subscription tier markers on pricing tables
avoid: Interactive buttons or clickable tags (use Badge or Button)
Overcrowding multiple ribbons on a single container

ai.purpose: Official accreditation, institutional verification mark, and royal stamp emblem.
whenToUse: Academic degree or course completion seals
Executive signature verification badges
Official institutional copyright or accreditation marks
avoid: Standard notification unread counts (use Badge)
User avatars (use Avatar)

keyboard_keys.ArrowDown: Opens menu or highlights next option

ai.purpose: Enables selection of a single option from an expandable dropdown list.
whenToUse: Choosing one option from 5 or more predefined choices (countries, roles, page sizes)
Page size selector in pagination pattern
Column/filter picker in data-table-toolbar
avoid: Binary choice (use Checkbox)
Mutually exclusive choices under 4 items (use Radio)

ai.purpose: Displays animated shimmer placeholders simulating layout geometry while asynchronous data loads.
whenToUse: Card loading state
Avatar and profile header loading
Table rows during pagination or initial fetch
avoid: Long-term blocking operations where progress percentage is known (use Progress)

ai.purpose: Indicates indeterminate background processing, data retrieval, or asynchronous task execution with an animated circular stroke.
whenToUse: Inside button during asynchronous submission (`loading` state)
Inside table rows or card bodies while fetching telemetry
Dropdown menu item lazy loading
avoid: Full-screen application bootup transitions (use Preloader)
Known percentage completion processes (use Progress)

ai.purpose: Guides users through a sequential multi-step workflow, depicting completed, active, and upcoming stages.
whenToUse: Multi-step enterprise registration (e.g. Register 2)
E-Commerce checkout (Cart -> Shipping -> Payment -> Confirmation)
Onboarding wizards and system setup procedures
avoid: Continuous percentage metrics without discrete steps (use Progress)
Independent tabs without chronological order (use Tabs)

ai.purpose: Enables users to toggle instantly between two mutually exclusive binary states (active / inactive, on / off).
whenToUse: Application settings and notifications switches
Dark/Light mode or language switching
Feature flags and privacy toggles
avoid: Form fields requiring delayed form submission button (use Checkbox)
Multiple selectable options from a set (use Radio or Select)

accessibility.focus: Table cells can receive focus if interactive

ai.purpose: Displays structured datasets organized in columns and rows for comparison.
whenToUse: Comparing uniform records (users, orders, invoices, transactions)
avoid: Mobile-first single-entity workflows (use Cards on small viewports)

keyboard.ArrowRight: Moves focus to next tab (LTR) or previous tab (RTL)
keyboard.ArrowLeft: Moves focus to previous tab (LTR) or next tab (RTL)

ai.purpose: Partitions content into parallel panels switchable via tab buttons.
whenToUse: Settings pages (Profile, Security, Billing)
Product overviews (Overview, Specs, Reviews)
avoid: Sequential multi-step forms (use Stepper/Wizard)

accessibility.focus: Border color changes to primary with ring focus

ai.purpose: Captures multi-line freeform textual data from the user.
whenToUse: Extended descriptions, reviews, notes, support messages
avoid: Short single-line fields (use Input)

ai.purpose: Presents a chronological sequence of events, operational milestones, or user activity logs connected by a vertical or horizontal axis.
whenToUse: Audit logs, order delivery history, and user activity streams
Organizational milestones, historical company chronologies
Task completion histories in project management dashboards
avoid: Linear multi-step forms where user input is required per step (use Stepper)
Unordered entity lists (use Table or Card)

ai.purpose: Displays temporary, non-blocking feedback notifications that auto-dismiss.
whenToUse: Confirming background operations ('Changes saved', 'Copied to clipboard')
avoid: Critical workflows requiring explicit user interaction before proceeding (use Modal)

keyboard.Escape: Dismisses tooltip while trigger retains focus

ai.purpose: Displays brief contextual assistance or explanation upon hover or keyboard focus.
whenToUse: Clarifying icon-only buttons (Save, Delete, Edit)
Explaining abbreviations or dense UI concepts
avoid: Crucial content required for basic interaction on mobile touch screens

keyboard_keys.ArrowDown: Moves focus to next tree item
keyboard_keys.ArrowUp: Moves focus to previous tree item
keyboard_keys.ArrowRight: Expands current item or moves to first child
keyboard_keys.ArrowLeft: Collapses current item or moves to parent

ai.purpose: Hierarchical list representation for displaying nested folders, categories, and deep tree structures with expand/collapse control.
whenToUse: Cloud storage file and folder directories
Deep multi-level taxonomy classification in admin panels
Codebase or documentation table of contents
avoid: Flat single-level lists (use Nav or List)

chat-stream.name: Chat Stream
chat-stream.purpose: Interactive conversational message stream for AI assistants and customer support, featuring message bubbles, file attachments, and prompt inputs.

ai.purpose: Conversational interface for LLM chats, customer support, and direct messaging
use_when: AI assistant prompts, customer service tickets, and team discussions
avoid_when: Static document presentation

confirmation.name: Confirmation Dialog
confirmation.purpose: Halts the user workflow to require explicit, deliberate confirmation before executing destructive, irreversible, or high-impact actions.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Focus is immediately trapped inside the dialog upon opening. Initial focus is placed on the cancel button (safer default for destructive actions). Escape cancels and closes the dialog. Tab cycles strictly between Cancel and Confirm buttons.

ai.purpose: Modal gatekeeper for destructive and irreversible actions
use_when: Deleting user accounts, resources, data tables, or irreversible configuration
Discarding unsaved changes with high data loss potential
avoid_when: Low-impact, reversible actions (use single-click action with undo Toast instead)
Simple informational messages (use standard Modal or Alert)

dashboard-stat.name: Dashboard Metric Card
dashboard-stat.purpose: Displays key performance indicators (KPI), primary metrics, trend percentages, and contextual comparisons.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab accesses clickable metric cards or interactive sparkline triggers. ARIA labels explicitly announce metric name, current value, and trend direction.

ai.purpose: Executive KPI metric display card
use_when: Top summary strips on executive dashboards, financial summaries, or system monitoring
Showing primary aggregated values with positive/negative growth indicators
avoid_when: Detailed time-series telemetry charts (use full Chart component)
Interactive form input fields

data-table-toolbar.name: Data Table Toolbar
data-table-toolbar.purpose: Combines search, filter toggles, bulk actions, column visibility, and export utilities above complex data tables.

responsive.sm: flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: var(--qhr-space-3);
responsive.md: flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab moves between search input, filter popovers, bulk action triggers, and export buttons. Left/Right arrow keys navigate between buttons within action groups.

ai.purpose: Operational control strip for administrative data tables
use_when: Complex data grids with multiple filter dimensions
Tables supporting multi-row selection and batch operations
avoid_when: Simple static tables (< 5 rows) without search or selection
Read-only summary tables in dashboards

date-paginator.name: Date Paginator Strip
date-paginator.purpose: Displays a horizontal scrollable day-by-day calendar navigation strip with active dates, day names, and previous/next interval controls.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Left/Right arrow keys navigate sequentially across dates.

ai.purpose: Horizontal daily calendar navigation strip
use_when: Event schedules, booking agendas, and appointment pickers
Daily activity logs, timesheets, and daily transaction filters
avoid_when: Selecting broad date ranges (e.g. quarterly or yearly date pickers)

editorial-story.name: Editorial Story
editorial-story.purpose: Presents a cinematic brand philosophy, heritage narrative, or craftsmanship story with dual-tone imagery, display typography, and poetic callout.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab traverses interactive action triggers within story columns

ai.purpose: Present brand storytelling, craftsmanship narrative, or heritage vision with rich typography and media framing.
use_when: Brand about pages, founder letters, craftsmanship features, or heritage overviews
avoid_when: Transactional checkouts, dense administrative forms, or rapid data processing views

empty-state.name: Empty State Container
empty-state.purpose: Informs the user that a collection, search query, or dashboard view contains no records, and provides an immediate recovery or creation action.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab moves focus directly to the primary creation/recovery action button. Screen readers announce the title followed by the helpful description.

ai.purpose: Zero-data feedback view with clear call-to-action
use_when: A search query yields zero results
A newly created account has no projects, documents, or items yet
A filter combination narrows results to empty
avoid_when: Network or server 500 error states (use an alert banner or full error boundary)
Loading or fetching states (use Skeleton loaders instead)

file-manager-grid.name: File Manager Grid
file-manager-grid.purpose: Digital asset management and cloud storage browser combining hierarchical treeview, file upload dropzone, storage meter, and grid items.

ai.purpose: Cloud drive and digital asset management browser
use_when: Document management systems, photo libraries, and enterprise media asset vaults
avoid_when: Simple single file inputs

filter-bar.name: Filter Bar
filter-bar.purpose: Displays active filtering criteria and quick category toggle chips with result counters.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Left/Right arrow keys navigate between filter chips. Enter or Space toggles active state. Tab exits the chip group to the clear-all button.

ai.purpose: Faceted category and tag filtering bar
use_when: Users need multi-select or single-select filtering on collections
Displaying applied filter state with quick removal badges
avoid_when: Complex nested SQL-like query builders
Primary navigation tabs (use Tabs component instead)

form-actions.name: Form Actions Bar
form-actions.purpose: Provides standard, accessible container for form submission, cancellation, and draft-saving controls.

responsive.sm: flex-direction: column-reverse; align-items: stretch; gap: var(--qhr-space-2);

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab moves logically between secondary (cancel) and primary (submit). Enter submits the parent form. Disabled actions announce aria-disabled="true" while preserving focusability.

ai.purpose: Consistent footer for form submission and cancel actions
use_when: At the bottom of modal dialogues, settings forms, or editor views
Ensuring primary submit button is paired with secondary cancel button
avoid_when: Single search inputs (use search-toolbar instead)
Placing more than one primary action in the same action bar

hero-skyline-panorama.name: Hero Skyline Panorama
hero-skyline-panorama.purpose: Full-bleed architectural brand hero layout pairing a clean, isolated typography column on one side with a bottom-anchored, full-height architectural skyline illustration on the other, blended seamlessly via feathered gradient masks and maintaining strict RTL/LTR symmetry with zero typography-visual collision.

responsive.desktop: height: clamp(500px, 62vh, 588px); display: flex; align-items: center;
responsive.mobile: height: auto; min-height: auto; max-height: none; flex-direction: column;

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab traverses interactive action triggers within the text column

ai.purpose: Provide a high-impact, culturally rooted architectural hero section for flagship portals and brand landings.
use_when: Flagship marketing landing pages
Cultural and regional product launches
Hero banners requiring seamless integration between architectural illustration and brand copy
avoid_when: Dense dashboard interfaces
Transactional checkout flows
Form-heavy administrative views

kanban-board.name: Kanban Board
kanban-board.purpose: Columnar agile workflow pattern organizing tasks, tickets, and pipeline states with draggable cards, priority badges, and user avatars.

ai.purpose: Pipeline workflow and task status management
use_when: Agile task tracking, support ticket queues, and recruitment CRM stages
avoid_when: Simple linear data lists (use Table instead)

luxury-product-card.name: Luxury Product Card
luxury-product-card.purpose: Displays a high-end fashion, jewelry, or accessory product with image container, material badge, pricing, and quick-add CTA.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab moves focus between image link, product title link, and quick-add action button

ai.purpose: Display high-end curated products with visual elegance, material tags, and intuitive purchase actions.
use_when: E-commerce product grids, luxury collections, seasonal drops, or featured catalog items
avoid_when: Dense spreadsheet-like inventory management tables with inline cell editing

metric-comparison-grid.name: Metric Comparison Grid
metric-comparison-grid.purpose: Side-by-side financial, analytical, and performance KPI comparison grid featuring trend chips, mini charts, and progress benchmarks.

ai.purpose: Financial portfolio and analytical metrics comparison
use_when: Fintech dashboards, trading platforms, executive KPI overviews
avoid_when: Textual narrative content

pagination.name: Pagination Control
pagination.purpose: Provides structured multi-page navigation, page jump buttons, and items-per-page selector.

responsive.sm: flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: var(--qhr-space-2);

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab navigates sequentially between previous, page numbers, next, and page size selector. Enter or Space triggers page selection. Current page item has aria-current="page".

ai.purpose: Data collection pagination and record boundary navigation
use_when: Result sets exceed a single viewport (typically > 20 records)
Server-paginated data tables and catalogs
avoid_when: Infinite scroll feeds (social media, media streams)
Short lists (< 10 items) where full display is clearer

questionnaire.name: Multi-Step Questionnaire & Assessment Flow
questionnaire.purpose: Orchestrates multi-step surveys, questionnaires, onboarding flows, and educational test assessments with single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform questions, progress tracking, and validation.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab navigates sequentially between question choices and action buttons. Arrow Up/Down cycles through choices in single-choice mode. Space selects or unselects choices. Keyboard shortcuts (A, B, C, D) or (1, 2, 3, 4) select answers directly. Enter triggers Next/Confirm action.

ai.purpose: Multi-step questionnaire, quiz, and survey assessment engine
use_when: Interactive educational tests and student knowledge assessments
Multi-step customer onboarding questionnaires and diagnostic intake flows
Public opinion polls, survey research, and multi-question evaluation forms
avoid_when: Single-field quick forms (use standard Input with Button)
Complex data entry tables with multiple simultaneous rows (use Table with Drawer)

search-toolbar.name: Search Toolbar
search-toolbar.purpose: Provides a cohesive, accessible search and filter bar for finding items within a collection or view.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab navigates sequentially from search input -> clear button (if visible) -> quick filter trigger -> submit button. Escape clears the search input when focused.

ai.purpose: Unified search and quick filtering header
use_when: Users need to filter or query a list, table, or catalog
Top of data tables, directory listings, and documentation search
avoid_when: Global header-level command palette (use a command modal dialog instead)
Single-field forms without filtering needs

sortable-list.name: Sortable Reorderable List
sortable-list.purpose: Provides intuitive drag-and-drop or keyboard-accessible reordering for priority lists, dashboard widgets, and task pipelines.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Items can be selected with Space/Enter and reordered using Up/Down arrow keys. Screen readers announce item repositioning with live region updates.

ai.purpose: Interactive drag-and-drop reordering pattern for priority items
use_when: Task queue prioritization and Kanban backlog arrangement
Rearranging modular dashboard widgets and card layouts
Menu item and navigation hierarchy customizers
avoid_when: Static read-only lists without customizable order

store-locator.name: Store Locator Card
store-locator.purpose: Displays flagship store, showroom, or boutique location details including branch name, address, hours, and direction actions.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab navigates through store phone link, directions button, and action controls

ai.purpose: Display physical showroom, store branch, or boutique locations with contact info and map links.
use_when: Store finder lists, branch directories, contact pages, or regional boutique hubs
avoid_when: Digital-only services without physical retail or pickup presence

user-card.name: User Profile Card
user-card.purpose: Displays rich author, team member, or customer profile summaries with avatar, biographical information, key statistics, and social action buttons.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab order cycles logically through profile links and action buttons.

ai.purpose: Composable profile card for team rosters, authors, and user directory rosters
use_when: Author spotlight sections in blogs and editorial widgets
Team rosters, leadership bios, and VIP membership profiles
Community member cards in directories and social feeds
avoid_when: High-density multi-row data tables with thousands of records (use Table)

vip-membership.name: VIP Membership & Loyalty Card
vip-membership.purpose: Displays a high-prestige loyalty tier card with metallic gold border, privileged benefits, and one-click subscription action.

accessibility.keyboard_flow: Tab traverses email input field and subscription CTA button

ai.purpose: Provide an elite customer subscription card with luxury gold framing and clear perks breakdown.
use_when: VIP membership programs, premium loyalty subscriptions, or executive access signups
avoid_when: Free standard newsletter signups (use simple form-actions or inline newsletter pattern)

alternatives.archive: Use when removal is reversible or soft-delete
alternatives.close: Use when dismissing transient dialog or notification

button.when: Triggering workflows, submitting forms, dismissing dialogs
button.why_not: Inline hyperlink navigation between external URLs (use <a> with link variant)

input.when: Short text values (names, emails, search queries, numbers)
input.how: Bind size and validation state (is-focused, is-disabled)
input.why_not: Multi-line text or predefined choice list

textarea.how: Set rows or min-height; use native or tailwind base

select.what: Single-choice picker from list of options
select.when: Categorical choices exceeding 5 options (countries, roles, dates)
select.how: Use custom qhrSelect behavior or native <select> fallback
select.why_not: Binary choices or small group under 4 options

checkbox.when: Terms agreement, multi-filter selection, batch table selection
checkbox.how: Bind checked state and accessible label

radio.what: Single selection among mutually exclusive choices
radio.when: Small option group (2-5 choices, e.g. shipping speeds, payment methods)

card.when: Product cards, dashboard widgets, summary profiles
card.how: Compose header, body, footer slots with variant (outline|elevated|flat)
card.why_not: Ephemeral blocking feedback (use modal or toast)

badge.what: Compact status, tag, or quantitative counter
badge.when: Entity status (Active, Inactive), category tags, unread counts

alert.what: Prominent contextual feedback banner within page flow
alert.when: System maintenance warnings, persistent form errors, instructions

toast.what: Floating temporary notification overlay with auto-dismiss
toast.how: Dispatch global 'qhr-toast-show' event with title and tone
toast.why_not: Critical blocking workflows requiring explicit user confirmation

modal.when: Destructive confirmations, single-step forms, focused attention
modal.how: Wrap with qhrModal; wire trigger, dialog, and escape handlers

dropdown.what: Action menu or navigation links revealed upon click
dropdown.when: Profile menus, overflow kebab actions (...) on table rows
dropdown.how: Wire qhrDropdown with trigger button and role='menu' list

tabs.what: Parallel view switcher dividing content into panels
tabs.how: Use role='tablist' with qhrTabs keyboard navigation

accordion.when: FAQs, detailed specifications, dense collapsible forms
accordion.how: Wire qhrAccordion with toggle(id) and isOpen(id)
accordion.why_not: When all sections must be visible simultaneously

table.what: Tabular data display structured in rows and columns
table.when: Comparing multiple items across uniform attributes

avatar.what: Visual entity identifier (photo or initials fallback)
avatar.when: User profile pictures, team members, comment authors
avatar.why_not: Full hero imagery or illustrative thumbnails

tooltip.what: Brief contextual label revealed on hover or focus
tooltip.why_not: Essential information required on mobile touch screens

navbar.what: Primary site header hosting branding and top navigation
navbar.when: Site-wide header across marketing sites or web apps
navbar.how: Bind qhrNavbar with mobile drawer toggle
navbar.why_not: Isolated landing pages with zero navigation

file-upload.when: Document uploads, media galleries, avatar uploads
file-upload.how: Bind qhrFileUpload with drag events and progress tracker

switch.when: Settings preferences, dark/light theme switching, instant activation
switch.how: Bind checked state with role='switch' and aria-checked
switch.why_not: Form submission where review is needed before commit (use checkbox)

callout.what: High-visibility contextual callout box with accent border
callout.when: Important notes, quotes, advisory tips, or highlighted snippets
callout.why_not: Ephemeral temporary toasts or full modal takeovers

progress.when: Multi-step workflows, file upload percentage, task completion
progress.how: Bind value (0-100), max, and tone with aria-valuenow

rating.when: Customer reviews, product feedback, satisfaction scores
rating.how: Bind qhrRating with interactive star selection and keyboard arrows
rating.why_not: Binary yes/no feedback (use button or radio)

skeleton.when: Simulating UI elements while async data is fetching
skeleton.why_not: Actions where a blocking preloader or spinner is expected

spinner.when: Async button submission, background fetching indicator
spinner.why_not: Known duration or percentage progress (use progress bar)

canvas-sparks.when: Luxury dark mode hero banners, celebratory landing headers
canvas-sparks.how: Layer behind content with pointer-events: none and aria-hidden='true'
canvas-sparks.why_not: Dense data tables, forms, or lightweight text documents

preloader.when: Initial site entry on luxury/media-rich web apps
preloader.how: Dismiss smoothly with opacity transition once DOM is ready

drawer.what: Sliding overlay panel anchored to viewport edge
drawer.when: Mobile navigation, shopping cart sheets, detail panels
drawer.how: Bind qhrDrawer with side (start|end|top|bottom) and focus trap

breadcrumb.what: Hierarchical trail navigation showing page depth
breadcrumb.when: Deep category structures, nested docs, e-commerce taxonomies

stepper.when: Multi-page checkout, wizard onboarding, approval flows
stepper.how: Bind active step index with completed and current states

treeview.what: Hierarchical nested directory and taxonomy tree
treeview.when: File managers, complex organizational charts, multi-level catalogs
treeview.how: Bind qhrTreeview with expandable nodes and keyboard navigation

back-to-top.what: Floating quick action returning user to page top
back-to-top.when: Articles, documentation, product catalogs with high scroll depth
back-to-top.how: Show after scroll threshold (e.g. 400px) with smooth scroll

chip.what: Compact pill for filters, selection tags, or removable values
chip.when: Applied search filters, multi-tag input, category toggles
chip.how: Bind removable attribute with close icon and click event

divider.what: Visual boundary separator with optional label
divider.when: Delineating distinct form sections or social auth separation

kbd.when: Documenting shortcut keys, command palette cues, cheat sheets

ribbon.what: Diagonal or corner decorative tag on cards
ribbon.when: Promotional flags (Sale, New, VIP, Featured) on product cards
ribbon.how: Position absolutely at corner with subtle rotation or banner style

timeline.what: Chronological vertical or horizontal event stream
timeline.when: Order tracking, activity history, company milestones, changelogs
timeline.how: Render chronological nodes with status markers and timestamps
timeline.why_not: Unordered random data lists (use table or card)

carousel.what: Interactive sliding media and card gallery
carousel.when: Featured product showcases, customer testimonials, banner carousels
carousel.how: Bind qhrCarousel with slide navigation and swipe support
carousel.why_not: Critical information that must be viewed simultaneously
